title: Add randomized anchor rebalancer and soft-fail multiplexer for CI-stable evals
author: Asha Kapoor
body:
Context and motivation: We intermittently see noisy CI failures from the eval suite caused by over-representation of small anchor prompt subsets and brittle hard-fail gating for non-deterministic probes. This PR introduces two complementary runtime/CI mechanisms to reduce false positives while preserving signal: (1) a randomized Anchor Rebalancer that detects cohort/anchor imbalance and reweights CI sampling in real-time to better reflect production request distributions; (2) a Soft-Fail Multiplexer (soft-fail-mux) that allows low-severity regressions to be demoted to a soft-fail state with automated escalation windows and telemetry hooks.

High level changes: Added eval_harness/anchor_rebalancer.py implementing a lightweight reservoir sampling + importance reweighting engine; added eval_harness/softfail_mux.py which decorates existing CI gate logic and implements configurable demotion windows, TTL-based escalations, and metadata tagging for downstream incident correlation. The CI pipeline gains a new job eval-shadow-prob-sampler that runs a small randomized shadow evaluation on each push/merge with a probabilistic seed to capture rare failure modes without flapping main gates. Configuration: eval_config.yaml gains an anchor_rebalance section (sample_ratio, max_reweight, seed_ttl) and a soft_fail section (thresholds, window_minutes, escalator_endpoint).

Design notes: Anchor rebalancer uses per-cohort counters and a decay window to compute skew; it applies multiplicative weights to the CI sampler to ensure underrepresented cohorts are sampled up to a max_reweight. This keeps CI cost bounded. The soft-fail mux exposes three policies: hard, soft, and auto. Auto demotes to soft on transient low-severity regressions and will automatically re-evaluate after the configured window; repeated occurrences within the window escalate to hard fail. Both components emit structured telemetry (eval.anchor.rebalance.event, eval.softfail.decision) sent to the existing metrics pipeline and linked in the rollback playbooks.

Test plan and checklist: - Unit tests for reservoir and weight math (anchor_rebalancer_test.py) - Integration tests that run the new CI job locally with deterministic seeds (ci/local_shadow_runner) - Added end-to-end smoke scenario that simulates cohort drift and verifies the rebalancer restores sampling mix within two windows - Added regression tests for demotion/escalation logic and TTL expiration - Updated changelog and docs/ci/anchor_rebalance.md with usage examples - Verified Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards show new series and created an alert template for repeated soft-fail escalations.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind eval_config.flags.anchor_rebalance and eval_config.flags.soft_fail_mux. Default to off for 48 hours, then enable in canary CI (runner pool: eval-canary). Monitor eval.alerts.softfail_escalation and token-level false-positive rate. If escalation rate exceeds 1% of merged-evals for 12 hours, automatically revert.

Related: Builds on prior work for cohort-aware samplers (ENG-1710) and the transient-rollforward gating RFC. References SUP-7291 for customer-reported noisy regression incidents.

Notes to reviewers: Focus review on the reweight math and the escalation window semantics. The rebalancer deliberately limits max_reweight to avoid overfitting to tiny cohorts; if product wants a more aggressive policy we can expose that via flags.
commits: Add anchor_rebalancer implementation and unit tests
Add softfail_mux decorator and integration tests
Add CI job eval-shadow-prob-sampler and pipeline wiring
Fix flake8 issues and tighten types on sampler
Add e2e smoke test and dashboard wiring
review_comments: Miguel Santos: Please add a short e2e smoke that runs the pipeline with a deterministic seed so we can reproduce the weighting behaviour in CI. Also call out the cost impact of the shadow sampler (expected +3% token budget).
Asha Kapoor: Added a deterministic smoke test and documented the expected +3% token budget in the docs. The rebalancer caps max_reweight at 5x by default to bound cost.
Olivia Chen: Can we make the soft-fail window configurable per-cohort? Some product cohorts are more sensitive.
Asha Kapoor: Done — softfail_mux now accepts an optional per-cohort override and falls back to a global default. Added tests for override behaviour.
Samir Patel: Lint caught an edge case in reservoir sampling when the cohort is empty; addressed in last commit. Approving once CI passes.
ci_checks_summary: Initial run: lint failed (flake8 import order). Second run: all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e smoke). Shadow sampler job marked flaky on first matrix row; retried automatically and passed. Full pipeline green before merge.
release_notes:
- Introduce randomized anchor rebalancer to reduce CI false positives by improving cohort sampling balance.
- Add soft-fail multiplexer to demote transient low-severity eval regressions and provide automatic escalation.
- Add eval-shadow-prob-sampler CI job for lightweight probabilistic shadow runs.
- New metrics: eval.anchor.rebalance.event, eval.softfail.decision.
post_merge_actions: Enable feature flag in canary CI after monitoring window
Add runbook snippet to ops playbook for soft-fail escalations
